title.narrative: Clean and Energy efficient cooking / fuel switch

description.narrative:
The overall goal of the Scaling clean cooking solutions in sub-Saharan Africa: Market Scoping and Design of A Results Based Financing Instrument is to scan and test the market for clean cooking solutions in urban Zambia, with a potential roll-out and further extension to other countries supported by Sida in sub-Saharan Africa (SSA).
Although the contribution targets Zambia and the Zambian context, it has a regional outlook and include an overview of the Clean Cooking market in other neighbouring countries. This to enable possible upscaling and coordination. The contribution is included as a separate sub-project in the ongoing contribution "Beyond the Grid Fund for Africa" (BGFA).This to facilitate consultations with other embassies and Sida's Power Africa Intitiative on a possible scaled-up.

NEFCO has undertaken a number of consultations over the reporting period in preparation for the foreseen clean cooking programme - with industry actors, financing agencies and investors. Further, the consultancy firm Open Capital Advisers (OCA) has been contracted to carry out the market scoping. With the interest of the Swedish embassies the region, Sida's Power Africa team engaged in the dialogue with NEFCO together with in particular embassies in Tanzania, Kenya, Mozambique and DRC who all decided to contribute to the new multi-country facility resulting from this contribution. The new Modern Cooking Facility for Africa with Planit ID 15042 is a results based programme for clean cooking solution with a total budget of 275 MSEK for DRC, Kenya, Tanzania, Mocambique and Zambia.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
